verdict.rationale: OpenCode's core function is generating AI insights/suggestions on your codebase: the 'plan' agent analyzes code and reviews suggestions without changes, a read-only agent explores codebases, and CLI usage like `opencode run "Explain how closures work"` demonstrates generating explanatory insights. Community feedback also praises the agentic harness quality for real code understanding tasks. Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of insight quality/accuracy, and no evidence of insights beyond code (e.g., aggregated project analytics).
